subject: general
question: There are three measuring Tapes which measure 56 cm, 64 cm and 80 cm in length. Find the least length that could be measured by using any of the three tapes. (Only one type of tape should be used at a time and only complete tape should be used to measure.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the **least length** that can be measured by all three **measuring tapes**, we must calculate their **Least Common Multiple (LCM)**.

Lengths are 56, 64, and 80 cm.

Divide by common factors: 8 × (7, 8, 10)

LCM = 8 × LCM(7, 8, 10) = 8 × 280

LCM = 2240 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 2240 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Tape 1 = 56 cm

Length of Tape 2 = 64 cm

Length of Tape 3 = 80 cm

**Formula Used:**

The **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** of a set of numbers is the smallest number that is a multiple of all the numbers in the set.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fae671d5654144044f951a1eac90af62acf2a8e351a72158324d1d1683c6d571.png] 

**Calculations:**

Using **Prime Factorization** method:

⇒ 56 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 7 = 2³ × 7

⇒ 64 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 2⁶

⇒ 80 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 = 2⁴ × 5

⇒ LCM = Highest power of each prime factor present in the numbers.

⇒ LCM = 2⁶ × 5¹ × 7¹

⇒ LCM = 64 × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM = 320 × 7 = 2240.

**∴ The correct answer is 2240 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

LCM is the smallest positive integer that is perfectly divisible by each of the given numbers. It is used to find the first instance where multiple periodic events coincide.

HCF and LCM Relationship

For any two numbers 'a' and 'b', the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).

Prime Factorization Method

To find LCM, express each number as a product of prime powers and select the highest power of every prime factor involved across all numbers.</p
